narration:2:1831402001:0.text: Once the skeleton horse is restored, it gets back on its feet.
narration:2:1831402001:0.source_cn: 骷髅马复原后，果然重新站了起来

narration:3:1831402002:0.source_cn: 然后……狠狠地踹了你一脚！

narration:4:1831402003:0.text: Before you can even react, it bolts.
narration:4:1831402003:0.source_cn: 在你尚未反应过来时，它便逃之夭夭
narration:4:1831402003:0.male: Before you can even react, it bolts.
narration:4:1831402003:0.female: Before you can even react, it bolts.

say:7:1831403001:0.text: It's a warhorse from Bantus, after all. Just as obnoxious as its former master.
say:7:1831403001:0.source_cn: 真不愧是班题斯的军马，和它的主人一样讨厌。
say:7:1831403001:0.male: It's a warhorse from Bantus, after all. Just as obnoxious as its former master.
say:7:1831403001:0.female: It's a warhorse from Bantus, after all. Just as obnoxious as its former master.
